name: velura-social
description: Post to and manage LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram from Claude through a local MCP server: publishing, comments, stats, cross-posting and scheduling.

linkedin_access_token.title: LinkedIn access token
linkedin_access_token.description: Leave empty to skip LinkedIn. Scopes: openid profile w_member_social, plus the organization scopes for a company page

linkedin_organization_id.title: LinkedIn company page ID (optional)
linkedin_organization_id.description: The number in linkedin.com/company/<id>/admin. Leave empty to post as your personal profile

meta_access_token.title: Meta access token
meta_access_token.description: Leave empty to skip Facebook and Instagram. A long-lived user token or Page token from your Meta app

facebook_page_id.title: Facebook Page ID
facebook_page_id.description: The Page to manage. Its linked Instagram professional account is found automatically
